notes: {"notes": "- **Playlists**: Downloaded YouTube playlists are watched for new videos. When someone adds one, it shows up in the bell with a Download button.\n- **Library**: Save to playlist is a small popup with covers and search, you can delete single videos from a pasted playlist, and playlist downloads fly onto their card.\n- **Fixes**: No more console windows flashing on screen, followed channels load again when YouTube's feed fails, the download slot no longer sticks during long batches, and the title bar avatar opens your profile.", "additions": ["Playlists: downloaded YouTube playlists are checked for new videos on the channel schedule, with a bell notice and a Download button", "Settings: Notifications > Watch downloaded playlists turns playlist checks off", "Library: Save to playlist is a small popup with playlist covers and search, video playlists only", "Library: delete single videos from a pasted playlist", "Library: playlist downloads fly onto their playlist card when the Playlists tab is open"], "fixes": ["Downloads: no console windows flash on screen after a download or when opening Settings > Downloads", "Downloads: the download slot no longer gets stuck on a finished cover during long batches", "Channels: followed creators keep loading new uploads when YouTube's channel feed fails, instead of Channel feed not found", "Library: playlist covers use the video thumbnail instead of its first frame", "Music: the title bar avatar opens your profile from the video library"]}
